scripts.dev: npm run build -w @karna/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,web,api "npm run dev -w @karna/shared" "npm run dev -w @karna/web" "npm run dev -w @karna/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @karna/shared && npm run dev -w @karna/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @karna/shared && npm run build -w @karna/api && npm run build -w @karna/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @karna/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @karna/shared && npm run test -w @karna/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @karna/shared && npm run test:integration -w @karna/api
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @karna/shared && npm run seed -w @karna/api
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run start -w @karna/web" "npm run start -w @karna/api"
